why: The containers.dev spec lets a repository keep several dev containers as .devcontainer/<folder>/devcontainer.json, one folder deep, and the Dev Containers extension writes customizations.vscode.settings into the container. Main read only .devcontainer/devcontainer.json, so the chat auto-approve key in a subfolder config was not applicable. Both sides track .devcontainer/python/devcontainer.json; the pass side turns auto-approve off and the fail side turns it on. Without the subfolder route the pass side is na instead of passou and the fail side is na instead of reprovou.
